name: query-rewriting
context: Retrieval quality is gated by query formulation: user questions are reformulated, decomposed, or expanded (HyDE, multi-query) before hitting indexes.
benefits: Large recall gains for vague queries
tradeoffs: Rewrites can drift from user intent
avoid_when: User queries are already well-formed and semantically precise
anti_patterns: HyDE hallucinations on niche domains (legal, biomedical, internal jargon)
best_practices: A/B test rewrites on eval sets
Cap expansions at three to five
Keep the original query in the mix
Measure recall@k and MRR before/after on labeled eval set
Use query classifier to selectively apply transformations
references: Ma et al., Query Rewriting for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models, EMNLP 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14283
